title: 海水腐蝕防護
summary: 把塗層、暴露面積、電位量測和厚度地圖串成腐蝕診斷，避免僅以平均值宣稱保護有效。 在腐蝕照片與電位資料室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
summaryEn: Connect coatings, exposure, potential measurements and thickness maps instead of declaring protection from averages. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Corrosion-image and potential-data studio. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 塗層缺損與暴露面積：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Coating breakdown and exposed area: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 塗層缺損與暴露面積 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Coating breakdown and exposed area and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「海水腐蝕防護」的「塗層缺損與暴露面積」中，塗層缺損率影響暴露面積，但電化學電流分佈仍不均勻。 本單元須將作用機制畫成有輸入、輸出與邊界的圖，並核對是否符合本課問題：把塗層、暴露面積、電位量測和厚度地圖串成腐蝕診斷，避免僅以平均值宣稱保護有效。
steps.instructionEn: Within Seawater corrosion protection, Coating breakdown and exposed area examines this mechanism: Coating breakdown affects exposed area, while electrochemical current distribution remains nonuniform. Draw inputs, outputs and boundaries, then relate it to the course question: Connect coatings, exposure, potential measurements and thickness maps instead of declaring protection from averages.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想教學台架，不可將不同單元數值拼成真實船舶規格。輸入：總面積 80 m²，缺損率0.03，示例電流密度0.08 A/m²。關係式 I=A f j；含單位換算算式 80*0.03*0.08 = 0.192 A。適用條件：教學需求帳，非陽極設計或保護電位規範。
steps.observationEn: This unit is an independent hypothetical teaching bench; values from different units must not be combined into vessel specifications. Inputs: Area 80 m², breakdown fraction 0.03 and illustrative current density 0.08 A/m². Relation I=A f j; expression including unit conversion 80*0.03*0.08 = 0.192 A. Applicability: Teaching demand balance, not anode design or a protection-potential rule.
steps.failure: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：只量單點電位會漏掉局部屏蔽或塗層脫離。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。
steps.failureEn: First examine this alternative cause: One potential measurement can miss shielding or disbonded coating. Compare its observable pattern with a genuine change in the input.
steps.check: 對「塗層缺損與暴露面積」，把電流需求與量測電位分開，畫出屏蔽區。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。
steps.checkEn: For Coating breakdown and exposed area, Separate current demand from measured potential and mark shielded regions. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.

knowledge.text: 在「塗層缺損與暴露面積」比較基準算式 80*0.03*0.08 與替代算式 80*0.06*0.08。先圈出唯一變動的輸入並預測增減，再計算 0.384 A，與基準 0.192 A 比較。保存輸入、單位、兩個輸出與一項不能外推的結論；只在數位模型或紙上進行。

Save inputs, units, both outputs and one conclusion that cannot be extrapolated; use only digital models or paper.
